source: Room-relative spots read from two captured Hypixel Floor I runs (2026-11-05), in each template's own unturned frame (block x/z from the room's north-west corner, y above the dungeon floor at 68). The captured rooms were matched to our templates block by block to find their turn. Mort: Entrance variant B (entrance_room) from both F1 runs and M7 runs 2 and 4, five blocks from the exit door's centre; variant A (start, the spawn-cave entrance) from M7 runs 1 and 3, four blocks from it. Both face away from the door into the room. Tomioka: the tomioka template (cut from M7 run 1), on the spruce ledge at local (27.5, 7, 4.5) facing west into the room; run 4 had the room turned 180 with him on the matching spot.

painting.note: M7 run 4 (2026-11-05) cell (0,5), room unturned: minecraft:painting graham facing EAST at (-189.97, 75.0, -23.5), anchor block (-190, 74, -24). It covers the 1 x 2 oak-wall-sign hole at (9, 6..7, 16), the catalogue's '1 - Entrance behind Painting'.
